pages.text: Hold a pipe in your $(thing)off hand$(). Look at a block: the route back to you appears as ghost pipes with the number needed, around obstacles and with as few turns as possible. Right-click to lay it.$(br2)The mode key (B by default) switches between Build for me and Curvy.
Each pipe is placed normally: protection mods apply, and survival uses up the off-hand stack. A pipe in the main hand always places a block pipe.
